summary.title: OSLO LUNSJ AS

narrative.text: OSLO LUNSJ AS is a Norwegian private limited company in "Drift av restauranter", registered 2013-06-24.
Registered activity: Catering. Drift av kantine.
Its own website describes it as: "Velkommen til Oslolunsj, catering, kantinedrift og utleie av lokaler, bestill enkelt med vår app og du får maten i morgen."
Latest filed legal-entity accounts for 2025 show revenue of NOK 34.4 million and an annual result of NOK -580,750.
Registered leadership: Pardis Rostamzei Torjali (Daglig leder); Ariel Glaser (Styrets leder).
Head office in Oslo, with 1 registered workplace.
Verified website: https://oslolunsj.no/; it links to facebook profiles.
Latest dated company publication: "GDPR - Oslolunsj - din lunsjleverandør" (2018-06-18).
Not established from permitted exact-entity sources: group, jobs. This is not proof of absence.
